researchFocus: Trace her Wimbledon titles and how she broke the color barrier in major tennis tournaments.

researchFocus: Built a research program in natural-products chemistry in India. Investigate her work on alkaloids and coumarins.

name: Claudia Alexander
researchFocus: Research her work on the Galileo mission and her role on the U.S. team for Rosetta.

researchFocus: Research her organizing with the Abeokuta Women’s Union in colonial Nigeria.
